model_status: Final frozen quadratic-uric-acid MIRASH model with development-derived screen-positive operating point

core_formula.note: No z-score standardization. Natural logarithms are applied to triglycerides and CRP only.

primary_output: Model-estimated sarcopenia probability = logistic(MIRASH linear predictor)

threshold.derivation_method: Youden J in CHARLS 2011 development data
threshold.classification_rule: probability >= exact cutoff => HIGH RISK / SCREEN POSITIVE
threshold.interpretation: Case-finding trigger for confirmatory sarcopenia assessment; not a stand-alone diagnosis

NHANES1999_2002.interpretation: external threshold transportability because outcome measurements/definitions differ from CHARLS

phenotype_framework: Six non-primary muscle-health phenotypes were evaluated at cohort level only and are not deployed as separate individual-level probability calculators.
privacy: All calculations are performed locally in the browser.
